subject: BlueCrest MAP: Onramp activation — keys, org setup, IP allowlist, peering
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Turner <sasha@bluecrest.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-20T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: BlueCrest MAP: Onramp activation — keys, org setup, IP allowlist, peering

Hi Sasha —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Based on our conversation I’ve sketched a compact mutual action plan (MAP) focused on environment activation for the 2-week eval: org bootstrap, API credentialing, IP allowlist, and VPC peering. I attached the MAP workbook (BC_MAP_v1.xlsx) and created a short doc with the recommended sequence: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1BlueCrest-MAP-Doc

High level asks we need from BlueCrest to hit the timeline:
- Confirm org admin account (preferred SSO & owner email) so we can create the tenant and seed service accounts.
- Confirm the first CIDR ranges for IP allowlist + static egress IP (Alexei if you can confirm).
- Approve the VPC peering template (attached) and nominate the cloud contact for peering tickets.
- Procurement to confirm PO timeline — we can stand up a sandbox without PO, but dedicated trial capacity needs a purchase path.

Suggested dates (two-week runway):
- Day 0 (Mon): org created + service account request
- Day 1–2: API keys issued (ephemeral + production-only keys)
- Day 3: IP allowlist applied and verification
- Day 4–7: VPC peering tickets in-flight and validation
- Week 2: integration smoke tests + throughput sanity check

Can you confirm owners for org, network (IP/CIDR), and procurement? If the timeline looks good we’ll lock dates and I’ll assign internal owners.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: BC_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), VPC_peering_template.txt (text)
From: Sasha Turner <sasha@bluecrest.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@bluecrest.ai>, Alexei Moroz <alexei@bluecrest.ai>
Date: 2028-06-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BlueCrest MAP: Onramp activation — keys, org setup, IP allowlist, peering

Thanks Naomi — this is clear and helpful. We can own the org admin confirmation and Alexei will own network details. Quick notes from our side:
- Org admin: I’ll send the SSO admin contact today (expected by EOD).
- IP allowlist: we can provide two /28 CIDR blocks for initial testing; Alexei copying here to confirm exact addresses.
- VPC peering: our security team requires the peering template to include minimal cross-account IAM. Can you point me to your peering contact and the expected Cloud provider (GCP/AWS/Azure)?
- Procurement: we prefer to finish the standard onboarding docs and PO next week; procurement copied for timeline. We may need a short-term demo license to run smoke tests while PO completes.

Also attaching our network contact notes and the completed security questionnaire (BlueCrest_Security_Questionnaire.pdf).

Would you be OK if we aim for the first activation by next Monday (2028-06-27) if we keep the current cadence?

Best,
Sasha
Director, Product — BlueCrest AI

> On Jun 20, 2028, at 2:05 PM, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai> wrote:
> > (See MAP + attached)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-21T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: BlueCrest MAP — owners & next steps

Team — Sasha confirmed ownership and tentative target (2028-06-27). I’m assigning owners so we can move fast:

- Marcus Lin: generate ephemeral API keys, build the token rotation guidance, and provide a one-click key activation script. Deliverable: keys + README by Thu 2028-06-23.
- Evelyn Hart: own VPC peering template updates and coordinate with Alexei. Deliverable: finalized peering template + requested tags/ARNs by Fri 2028-06-24.
- Jordan Blake: coordinate IP allowlist application and egress validation. You’ll need Alexei’s CIDRs — reach out and confirm. Deliverable: confirmation of allowlist applied & curl-based verification by Mon 2028-06-26.
- Neha Kapoor: collate SOC2 artifacts and the runtime logging excerpt BlueCrest requested; be ready for procurement. Deliverable: artifact list + sample logs by Fri 2028-06-24.

I’ll operate as primary customer contact and track the MAP workbook. Marcus — I gave you edit rights on the MAP doc (link included in the external thread). Please flag any blockers — if we need to shift the cutover date we’ll propose 2028-07-03 instead.

Thanks —
Naomi

Quoted: Sasha’s note for context.
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Turner <sasha@bluecrest.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procure@bluecrest.ai>
Date: 2028-06-24T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BlueCrest MAP: Onramp activation — keys, org setup, IP allowlist, peering (confirmed owners & schedule)

Sasha — quick update and confirmation of dates after internal sync.

Confirmed owners and near-term milestones (same MAP doc updated):
- 2028-06-23: Naomi to create tenant + Marcus to seed ephemeral keys (action: Naomi/Macrus).
- 2028-06-24: Alexei confirms CIDRs; Jordan applies allowlist and reports verification (action: Jordan/Alexei).
- 2028-06-25–27: Evelyn to complete peering config; network validation windows scheduled with BlueCrest.
- 2028-06-27: smoke tests and first tokenized requests (target).

Procurement — if you can issue a short-term demo license or a confirmation email to allow dedicated trial capacity we’ll prioritize isolated capacity for BlueCrest.

Attached: updated MAP workbook (BC_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a lightweight peering template (VPC_peering_template.txt). I’ll also send a DocuSign for the evaluation addendum once procurement confirms the PO path.

If the timeline still looks good on your end, please reply with a single line: "Approve MAP schedule" and we’ll lock the dates.

Cheers,
Naomi Feldman
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: BlueCrest_Security_Questionnaire.pdf (received), BC_MAP_v1.xlsx (updated), VPC_peering_template.txt (updated)
